environment: LINUX-CPU (no pose extraction, no Mac/iPhone measurements; deterministic parsing contract only — no speech engine)
scope: Voice/tap technique intent robustness: transcript-in → intent-out contract over the 61-technique taxonomy

capture_paths: apps/mobile/src/flow/TechniqueIntentPicker.tsx (tap grid + typed/dictated text + AUTO chip → TechniqueIntent)
apps/mobile/src/analysis/runCaptureAnalysis.ts (stroke: { declared, predicted: null } — declared/predicted separate records)
packages/analysis-pipeline/src/strokeAutoResolution.ts (declared-vs-predicted contract: declaration selects profile, never forces prediction; disagreement surfaced, never silently resolved)
audit.declared_prior_contract: UNCHANGED and respected: voice resolution only produces declarations; predictedStroke remains a separate envelope field (StrokeIntentEnvelope). No thresholds/denominators/contracts weakened.

contract.resolver: resolveVoiceTechniqueIntent(transcript): deterministic bounded keyword grammar; every output terminates in PICKLEBALL_TECHNIQUES (61 slugs) or explicit auto/unknown
contract.leaf_rule: leaf committed only when the transcript's own words fully specify exactly one taxonomy slug (all slug components mentioned + side spoken when the slug has one)
contract.coarse_rule: 'forehand' → side-level candidate set; 'dink' → family-level candidate set; never an invented L3
contract.unknown_rule: no technique vocabulary → status unknown + re-prompt copy; picker shows the copy and keeps the tappable grid (existing design-system pattern)
contract.projection: projectVoiceResolution → SELECTABLE_TECHNIQUES_V1 (capture-selectable registry); taxonomy techniques with no selectable analog (lobs, counters, specialty) project to honest unknown, never rounded

implemented.wiring: TechniqueIntentPicker now resolves typed/dictated text through voice-intent-v1 + projection (same IntentResolution shape as before; unknown hint now shows the resolver's re-prompt copy)

evidence.mobile_jest_full_suite: 36 suites / 327 tests passed (was 30 suites / 214 per HANDOFF_V3; +voiceIntentCorpus.test.ts with 61 tests over a clearly-synthetic 56-phrase corpus: 32 leaf, 11 coarse, 6 auto, 7 unknown)

corpus_note: Phrase corpus is SYNTHETIC (hand-written transcripts in apps/mobile/__tests__/voiceIntentCorpus.test.ts). No speech-engine work; no real user speech; no Mobbin research performed (MCP unavailable).
